  - heading "From the manufacturer" [level=2]
  - heading "Product information" [level=1]
      - paragraph: I’m using this switch for a home network, powering a tablet kiosk, and an access point and at the same time disabling some ports to just provide the data for smart TVs, work laptop and a Mac mini. It’s a great option to be able to combine a switch with POE instead of using it separate injectors that just require additional outlets for power. At least in my application, it’s working really well and I’m pairing it with a USB-C splitter from POE Texas for powering my tablet that uses WiFi. The switch allows me to disable the power and also allows me to adjust the amount of wattage to come out of each port. Very satisfied , however, it would really be great if these 5 and 8 port switches had rackmount options from the manufacturer but there are some sellers on Etsy that 3d print rack options for some of the more popular smaller switches

selectionDisposition.purchaseBoundary: Consider it when a jogging route and the child’s readiness justify this larger stroller. BOB recommends jogging only over eight months, with individual pediatric guidance. Match the supplied serial-specific guide, secure wheels, lock the front wheel in jog mode, use the upright seat, fitted harness and wrist strap, and inspect tire pressure before use. 【HDMI Display Port KVM Switch for 2 Monitors and 2 Computers】This HDMI + DisplayPort KVM switch allows you to input HDMI and DisplayPort video signals, as well as USB from two computers, and output them to two monitors, enabling you to share a dual-monitor setup across multiple PCs. It also features four USB 3.0 ports for sharing keyboards, mouse, printers and more. You can easily switch between them with the press of a button. LED indicators clearly show which computer is active.【Important Notes】Please make sure each of your computers has a DisplayPort, an HDMI port, and a USB-A port and that all ports are properly connected. Docking stations and additional adapter cables are not supported.
【4K@60Hz High-Resolution Output】The KVM DP HDMI switch box supports up to 4K (3840×2160) resolution at 60Hz, delivering sharp images and smooth motion without signal degradation. It is good for office tasks, web browsing, and video playback. The HDMI switcher is also backward compatible with 4K@30Hz and 1080p@60Hz, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of monitor. Note: To achieve 4K@60Hz, the computer, HDMI cable, DP cable and monitors must all support 4K@60Hz. For best performance, the cable length should be under 9.8ft(3 meters).
【4 High-Speed USB 3.0 Ports】This DisplayPort HDMI KVM switch 2 monitors 2 computers Display Port features four USB 3.0 ports, allowing up to four USB devices to be shared between two computers. In addition to keyboards and mouse, you can connect USB flash drives, printers, webcams, and more. With USB 3.0 support, data transfer speeds of up to 5Gbps are possible, making large file transfers faster and more efficient. It is also backward compatible with USB 1.1/2.0, ensuring older peripherals work seamlessly.
【Two Ways of Switching】The KVM switch HDMI DisplayPort offers flexible and convenient switching methods, including a physical button on the main unit and a wired desktop remote controller, making it easy to switch between two connected computers. The physical button ensures intuitive operation with minimal risk of accidental input and the wired desktop remote allows quick switching without touching the main unit. Please Note: Keyboard hotkey switching is not supported.
【Wide Compatibility】This KVM switches is compatible with most major operating systems, including Windows, Linux, and Chrome OS, and supports most HDMI + DisplayPort source devices. In addition, This monitor switch for 2 computers features a high-dissipation metal casing, enabling stable operation at temperatures up to 50°C. The metal casing minimizes failure points, enhances long-term reliability, and ensures quiet, comfortable use even during continuous operation. To ensure stable video output, please connect the included USB power cable before use.
【Important Notices】1. Please make sure each of your computers has a DisplayPort, an HDMI port, and a USB-A port, and that all cables are connected correctly. 2. Each computer must support dual-display output simultaneously. Test method: Connect the computer directly to two monitors without using the KVM switch. 3.Many macOS laptops do not have a DisplayPort port and are therefore not compatiblewith this product. 4. Docking stations and additional adapter cables are not supported. 5. Please connect the included USB power cable before use. 6. Modern monitors often have multiple HDMI/DP inputs, please manually select the correct input source in the monitor settings.

(Note: The A3 flatbed uses a CIS sensor that can only scan flat paper images, not three-dimensional items. Otherwise, it will lead to unclear or blurred scanning results. ERGONOMIC WRIST RELIEF & LIBRARY-QUIET CLICKS: Stop torturing your wrist during the 9-to-5 grind. Plus, the versatile bluetooth mouse pairs seamlessly with iPad, Windows PC, and Mac, letting professionals switch instantly between three devices without missing a beat
CRUSH SPREADSHEETS WITH DUAL SCROLL WHEELS: Stop dragging your cursor across multiple screens. PINPOINT ACCURACY ACROSS ANY WORKSPACE: Whether making pixel-perfect edits in Photoshop or dragging files across multiple monitors, the Philips computer mouse never lags. A MONTH OF POWER & 5-MINUTE EMERGENCY TOP-UP: Dead batteries mid-meeting are a nightmare common to standard wireless mice. The Philips rechargeable ergonomic mouse utilizes a 500mAh battery and smart auto-sleep to conquer a 25-day heavy workload (8 hours/day). Losing power before a critical Zoom pitch?
